showcase_story: The trigger drawer's top button plays the packet's 25 required story beats in order on thread-17 (runShowcase in shared/triggers.js): long request, goal start, BSD evaluation, history retrieval, full questionnaire lifecycle, eight todos, multi-phase activity, port collision, three children on distinct routes, capacity 2+1, child block/retry, route warning, attachment resolution, three-file diff, four artifacts, artifact open left, pinned history with artifact, offline queued send with exactly-once replay, active-turn redirect, thread request/response, goal pause/resume/block/recover/complete, final receipt, and branch. Verified 25/25 to completion.
